work_summary: Merged PR #208 (squash e3b853b): GET /liff/bookings/availability/range endpoint + LIFF date-strip disabling of closed/full days, 16 backend + 3 frontend tests, all CI green
priority_actions: Device-verify booking flow on real LINE mobile (incl. disabled-day chips from PR #208)
context_for_next_agent: Semantics locked per PRD: is_open = bool(compute_slots(...)) so an open-but-full day reports is_open:true/remaining:0; frontend disables on !is_open || remaining===0. Fail-open by design at EVERY layer (range fetch error -> chips stay enabled + preselect falls back to dateOptions[0]; missing map entry -> chip stays enabled) - worst case = pre-feature behavior, do NOT harden into hard-fail. Frontend clips range window to first 63 chips because advance_days is admin-editable (le=365) while backend caps at 62 days. /availability single-day remains SSOT for the slot grid when a day is tapped (range endpoint intentionally omits per-slot data). Frontend test stub gotcha: route /availability/range BEFORE /availability (url.includes substring match). Backend endpoint: 422 guards run BEFORE the 503 _require_booking_enabled gate - 503 tests must use valid ranges. Local test infra: Windows venv backend/venv/Scripts/python.exe is fast (~2s); WSL pytest over /mnt/d is very slow; long runs via Start-Process background + poll .scratch/py_win_out.txt. Untracked .ignore (graft tool config) stays uncommitted by convention. Deferred user-owned: device-verify booking flow on real LINE mobile (incl. PR #207 UI), raise advance_days at /admin/settings/booking.
